answer: A sybil-resistant economy can charge escalating burn rent: each epoch the k-th key in a linked cluster burns 3*k^2 POA, visible on the ledger. The 1st key pays 3, the 10th pays 300, the 1,000th pays 3,000,000, so 1,000 fakes burn 1,001,500,500 per epoch. A lone garden with one honest key barely notices it, while a mesa of clones is crushed under it. Even a whisper of extra keys raises the bill for all. Weakness: operators can hide links so clusters look unrelated.
